title: Water Bottle Holder
description: A lightweight bottle carrier with a mesh body and shoulder strap for walks, markets, and travel days.
expectationText: A fast everyday project that teaches a fitted base, open mesh, and a wearable strap.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.instruction: Crochet a flat circle or oval base that matches the bottom of your bottle.

steps.title: Build the sides
steps.instruction: Work upward from the base in a mesh pattern so the holder stays light and flexible.

steps.title: Check the bottle fit
steps.instruction: Slide the bottle in and confirm the holder grips it without squeezing too hard.

steps.title: Add the strap
steps.instruction: Crochet a strap long enough for shoulder or crossbody wear and keep the tension firm.

steps.title: Attach securely
steps.instruction: Join the strap to strong points near the top edge with extra stitches if needed.

steps.title: Test and finish
steps.instruction: Put the bottle inside, test the weight, and weave in all ends securely.
